import java.io.InputStreamReader;
import java.io.PrintWriter;
import java.math.*;
import java.util.*;

public class E {

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        new E().execute();
    }

    private void execute() {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = scanner.nextInt();
        long kt = scanner.nextLong();

        if (kt >= n) {
            System.out.println(0);
            return;
        }

        int k = (int) kt;
        long mod = 998244353L;
        long[] factorials = new long[n + 1];
        factorials[0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            factorials[i] = (factorials[i - 1] * i) % mod;
        }

        long ans = 0;
        int c = n - k;
        for (int i = 0; i <= c; i++) {
            long comb = (factorials[c] * modInverse(factorials[i], mod) % mod) * modInverse(factorials[c - i], mod) % mod;
            long power = modPow(c - i, n, mod);
            long t = (comb * power) % mod;
            if (i % 2 == 0) {
                ans = (ans + t) % mod;
            } else {
                ans = (ans - t + mod) % mod;
            }
        }
        long totalComb = (factorials[n] * modInverse(factorials[n - k], mod) % mod) * modInverse(factorials[k], mod) % mod;
        ans = (ans * totalComb) % mod;
        if (k > 0) {
            ans = (ans * 2) % mod;
        }
        System.out.println(ans);
        scanner.close();
    }

    private long modInverse(long a, long m) {
        return modPow(a, m - 2, m);
    }

    private long modPow(long base, int exp, long mod) {
        long result = 1;
        long b = base % mod;
        int e = exp;
        while (e > 0) {
            if ((e & 1) == 1) {
                result = (result * b) % mod;
            }
            b = (b * b) % mod;
            e >>= 1;
        }
        return result;
    }
}
